search_text: published ZDI-21-1277 ZDI-CAN-13968 (0Day) Bitdefender Total Security Unnecessary Privileges Local Privilege Escalation Vulnerability 2021-11-03 CVE-2021-3579 , CVE-2021-3576 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2021-3579 7.0 AV:L/AC:H/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['Bitdefender'] ['Total Security'] This vulnerability allows local attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of Bitdefender Total Security. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the endpoint client. The issue results from allowing an untrusted process to impersonate the client of a pipe. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code in the context of SYSTEM.
